item.title: 🟠 Critical Gitea Flaw Let Unauthenticated Attackers Read Server Files via Org-Mode Markup
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality system impact — check guest-facing services and PMS/POS status.
An unauthenticated attacker can read any file the service account can access on Gitea, the self-hosted Git platform, in versions 1.22.1 through 1.27.0. No login, no repository write access. A public repository and crafted Org-mode markup are enough. The flaw is fixed in Gitea 1.27.1. item.title: 🟠 Leaked n8n API Tokens Exposed Live Instances to Credential Theft
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.

item.title: 🔴 QuickFox Supply Chain Attack Delivers FDMTP Backdoor via Trojanized Windows Installer
item.description:
